Name: Sleepy's Bearded Dragons
Author: OkaySleepy
Description:
This Mod replaces the basic Stardew cat textures with new bearded dragon textures
The audios remain the same, but they now look like bearded dragons! (Including black beards when pouncing!)

To install:
Go into your Stardew Valley files (Likely "[b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley[/b]" without the ")
Open the "Content" file
Open the "Animals" file
Drag the "cat" bearded dragon files into the folder and replace the original ones!
[b][size=4](Do NOT forget to save and backup the original "cat" files before replacing them!!)[/size][/b]

Cat to Dragon Guide:
1st Cat -> Orange Beardie
2nd Cat -> Red Beardie
3rd Cat -> Tan Beardie
4th Cat -> White Beardie
5th Cat -> Black beardie
Purple Cat -> Purple Beardie
